lectures.title: 逻辑回归 · 中文精解

points.text: 监督学习学的是从输入到输出的预测函数——「学习」的全部信息来自带正确答案的样本，而不是写死的规则。
points.html: 监督学习学的是从输入到输出的预测函数——「学习」的全部信息来自带正确答案的样本，而不是写死的规则。

points.text: 回归与分类的差别只在标签：连续值学回归，离散类别学分类；模型形式可以完全相同。
points.html: 回归与分类的差别只在标签：连续值学回归，离散类别学分类；模型形式可以完全相同。

points.text: 概率推理的全部计算都从两条法则出发：乘法法则把联合概率拆开，求和法则做边缘化。
points.html: 概率推理的全部计算都从两条法则出发：乘法法则把联合概率拆开，求和法则做边缘化。

points.text: 贝叶斯法则把「模型生成数据的概率」反过来求「数据支持下模型的概率」——先验 × 似然 ∝ 后验。
points.html: 贝叶斯法则把「模型生成数据的概率」反过来求「数据支持下模型的概率」——先验 × 似然 ∝ 后验。

points.text: 任何概率模型都必须回答三个问题：怎么表示、怎么推断、怎么学习——本课后续全部内容都挂在这三问上。
points.html: 任何概率模型都必须回答三个问题：怎么表示、怎么推断、怎么学习——本课后续全部内容都挂在这三问上。

points.text: Supervised learning fits a predictive function from "input + correct answer" pairs — the information all comes from labeled samples, never from hand-written rules.
points.html: Supervised learning fits a predictive function from "input + correct answer" pairs — the information all comes from labeled samples, never from hand-written rules.

points.text: Regression and classification differ only in the label: continuous values vs discrete classes — the model form can be identical.
points.html: Regression and classification differ only in the label: continuous values vs discrete classes — the model form can be identical.

points.text: Every probability calculation builds on two rules: the product rule splits a joint probability apart, the sum rule marginalises.
points.html: Every probability calculation builds on two rules: the product rule splits a joint probability apart, the sum rule marginalises.

points.text: Bayes' rule turns "how likely is the data under a model" into "how plausible is the model given the data" — prior × likelihood ∝ posterior.
points.html: Bayes' rule turns "how likely is the data under a model" into "how plausible is the model given the data" — prior × likelihood ∝ posterior.

points.text: Every probabilistic model must answer three questions: how to represent, how to infer, how to learn — the rest of the course hangs on them.
points.html: Every probabilistic model must answer three questions: how to represent, how to infer, how to learn — the rest of the course hangs on them.
